templates.name: Blank Web App
templates.description: Mobile-first VIVERSE utility app baseline. Auth optional, no Lambda. Ideal for polls, countdowns, welcome screens, and simple interactive tools embeddable as iframe widgets.
templates.recommendedPrompt: Create a new utility app using template 'blank-webapp-v1'. Keep auth bootstrap and config resolution intact. Build the app UI and logic in src/ within the editable surface.

templates.name: DashRunner Template
templates.description: Three.js endless runner template with VIVERSE auth, leaderboard, matchmaking room flow, and avatar-aware VRM runtime.
templates.recommendedPrompt: Use template 'dashrunner-v1' — but change the character model, obstacle style, and visual theme to something new.

templates.name: Flow Line Template
templates.description: PlayCanvas puzzle template with VIVERSE auth, compact profile chip, and level-progress leaderboard submission for mobile-first world previews.
templates.recommendedPrompt: Use template 'flow-line-v1' — but change the color palette, board style, and visual theme to something new.

templates.name: Lambda Tool
templates.description: Mobile-first VIVERSE tool app with Play Lambda backend for secure external API access. Auth required. Use for data-driven tools like tickers, weather widgets, AI chat, and any app needing third-party API keys.
templates.recommendedPrompt: Create a new Lambda-backed tool app using template 'lambda-tool-v1'. Keep auth, Lambda invoke client, and config resolution intact. Add lambda event scripts in lambda/ and build the app UI in src/ within the editable surface.

templates.name: RedPointFish Template
templates.description: Polished RedPointFish multiplayer poker template with VIVERSE auth/matchmaking and leaderboard flow.
templates.recommendedPrompt: Use template 'redpointfish-v1' — but change the card art, table theme, and UI colors to something new.

templates.name: Starter Kit Racing Template
templates.description: Three.js racing template with VIVERSE auth, leaderboard, and closed-loop random track generation.
templates.recommendedPrompt: Use template 'starter-kit-racing-v1' — but change the car model, track theme, and visual style to something new.

templates.name: TankArena 3D Template
templates.description: Fixed-camera 3D tank arena template with auth, leaderboard, matchmaking room lifecycle, heavy weapons, and random battlefield generation.
templates.recommendedPrompt: Use template 'tankarena-3d-v1' — but change the tank models, arena theme, and visual effects to something new.

templates.name: Flight Simulator Template
templates.description: Three.js 3D flight simulator with VIVERSE auth, global leaderboard, ring-collection scoring, and procedural terrain.
templates.recommendedPrompt: Use template 'flight-simulator-v1' — but change the aircraft model, ring visuals, and overall theme to something new.

templates.name: Gaussian Splat Library
templates.description: Interactive 3D prop library and scene composer with Gaussian splat support. Upload GLB or PLY worlds, walk around them in first-person, generate AI-textured props via Meshy, and compose scenes with automatic PLY collision mesh generation.
templates.recommendedPrompt: Use template 'gaussian-splat-library-v1' to build a 3D scene viewer or prop composer. You can customise the scene background, default lighting, sidebar controls, and Meshy generation defaults. Do not modify vite.config.js or the src/collision/ pipeline.
